name: anofox-statistics
description: SQL-native statistical regression and inference skills for the anofox_statistics DuckDB extension — regression (OLS/robust/GLM/ordinal/multinomial/AFT/Cox PH/GLS/P-spline/mixed-effects, splines, Wald chunk tests, effects and nomograms, validate/calibrate/bootcov, multiple imputation, cluster-robust vcov, paths and CV, predictions with standard errors), hypothesis tests (TOST, ANOVA incl. two-way/repeated measures, drift and multivariate two-sample tests), post-hoc, time-series, survival tests and classifier evaluation, diagnostics (influence, residuals, autocorrelation, heteroskedasticity, VIF/GVIF, condition indexes, separation, accuracy indexes, variable clustering and redundancy), AI-ready batch per-group model fitting, and plot-ready long tables for anofox-visualization.
